conclusion_zh: 输入多、输出少是当前 W4A16 量化端到端相对收益有限的主要原因；语言 prefill 和未量化的视觉编码成本占据较大部分，而量化明显加速的 decode 次数少。已有结果足以回答问题，停止扩大实验。此结论不等于所有精度、内核和系统优化都无法进一步提速。

fixed_input_9_images_18_output.measurement_caveat: GPU phase events and HTTP measurements have different boundaries; sums of component medians are not an exact critical-path decomposition.

matched_history_replay.interpretation: System optimization improves FP16 and quantized models alike. The roughly 53% AWQ system improvement is not an intrinsic quantization speedup. Relative total-HTTP quantization benefit is essentially unchanged.
limitations: One replay pass per configuration; not a navigation success-rate evaluation.
Two long historical trajectories account for 284 of 343 requests.
All 343 same-weight old/new token sequences matched.

quality_validation.scope: This validates the system change on the frozen 20-episode roster; it does not establish population-level statistical equivalence or compare different models on identical navigation paths.

mechanism.weight_only_quantization: Reduces weight-memory traffic, benefiting batch-1 single-token decode. The current W4A16 path dequantizes weights for FP16 matrix operations.
mechanism.prefill: Processes many input tokens with greater weight reuse and is relatively more compute-bound; memory transfers still occur. Quantization does not guarantee prefill acceleration.
mechanism.reference_section: Appendix A, weight-only versus weight-and-activation quantization
